target: opening-to-actual-start days conditional on completed external fill; log1p training

ridge.selection: native mean development MAE; ties block

eligibility: Exact native evaluator: all four folds and calendar coverage must pass; blocked histories receive no candidate score or fit
testBoundary: Native development windows July 2025 through March 2026; train before April 2026; holdout opening cohort April-June 2026 observed through October 3 2026. Training labels must be started, closed and first-observed by origin. No holdout tuning.

criteria.decision: Each tree adopted for synthetic demo only if all criteria pass versus every comparator in reference and every eligible stress scenario. Missing-label and small-support must remain blocked. Insufficient scenario support is unsupported, never evidence of efficacy. No second tuning attempt.

publication: Aggregate seed/scenario/fold metrics and provenance only; no requisition rows or IDs persisted
limitations: Synthetic independent scenario histories, not company evidence
Calendar-only conditional duration regression, not all-opening completion probability or survival model
Unresolved/cancelled/missing labels remain unscored and eligible histories require at least 90 percent observed; no censoring adjustment
No person scoring, staffing availability, deployment or production changes
